pain_addressed: Citizens struggle to find services in a flat list of 500+ rows.
sympho_feature: AI-Powered Service Discovery & Natural Language Search
description: An interactive chatbot assistant (Ask Sympho) that translates natural language intents (e.g., 'I want to apply for a college fee concession') directly into the correct service recommendation ('First Graduate Certificate') and guides the user through the process.
impact_metrics: 90% reduction in discovery search time, eliminates navigation steps.

pain_addressed: Citizens must repeatedly upload the same documents (Aadhaar, Ration Card) for different applications.
description: A secure personal vault that saves and encrypts citizen documents upon first upload or pulls them directly from DigiLocker. Subsequent applications auto-reference the saved files with a single click.
impact_metrics: Eliminates redundant file uploads entirely, prevents document loss errors.

pain_addressed: Services list document requirements as 'NA' or hide them until mid-application.
description: Shows an upfront, clear, multi-language list of mandatory vs optional documents before the citizen begins filling out a form, complete with sample images or templates.
impact_metrics: Lowers rejection rates due to missing paperwork by 40%.

pain_addressed: Status checking is fragmented across three URLs with vague government terminology.
description: Renders a clean progress bar showing exactly where the application is in the process (e.g. 'VAO Verified', 'With Tahsildar') with expected SLAs and simple-language status descriptions.
impact_metrics: Drastically reduces citizen anxiety and status-lookup support requests.
